description: This file contains the implementation of PoolingStreamBufferWriter, a struct that adapts a Stream to the IBufferWriter<byte> interface in C#. It manages internal buffer allocations and writes data from the buffer to the stream, using pooled byte arrays for efficiency.

classes.name: PoolingStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> that writes to a stream using pooled buffers.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Writes data to the stream from the buffer.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> segment for writing.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> segment for writing.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the internal buffer when needed.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Returns the buffer to the pool when no longer needed.
